crossRefs.note: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of…
Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to…
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the…
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

translations.web: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
translations.bsb: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
translations.kjv: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance
translations.asv: Many there are that say, Who will show us any good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
